recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reapply FHIR-14824 to the current base Encounter resource; use realm or use-case profiles for contexts that need Encounter.class 1..1, consistent with FHIR-39014.
issue_request: FHIR-14824 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested Encounter.class be mandatory 1..1 because the Encounter notes described class as required and classHistory.class was already 1..1.
initial_application: The issue was applied by d9eb43b4d33236a32920636c5450e52ea95e3851, titled GF#14824: Make Encounter.class mandatory (1..1), in the historical source/encounter/encounter-spreadsheet.xml. The Jira comments also state that Encounter.class was already 1..1 in the then-current build.
additional_context: FHIR-32341 was later Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and resolved Encounter.class to 0..* CodeableConcept with a preferred binding. FHIR-32342 made the element CodeableConcept. FHIR-39014 challenged the R5 change and was Resolved - No Change, explaining that legacy and jurisdictional variation make a base 1..1 requirement inappropriate and that profiles can require class. FHIR-42918 then corrected the stale notes text from required to should be provided.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The active source/fhir.ini includes Encounter, and source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml currently defines Encounter.class as 0..* CodeableConcept with a preferred EncounterClass binding. source/encounter/encounter-notes.xml now says class should be provided, so restoring 1..1 would contradict later final PA decisions.
